resources.string: Audio associated with saved meditations counts as Offline meditations, including partial recordings and matching provider caches. Each file counts once. Other audio is unlinked audio, migration backups and temporary shared MP3s. Sizes exclude the installed app.
Stop playback, sharing and offline preparation before deleting audio.
Audio cleanup is running. Please try again when it finishes.
Could not measure storage. Please try again.
Some audio files could not be deleted. Please refresh and try again.

Delete audio not associated with saved meditations, including unused caches, temporary files and old migration backups? Audio associated with saved meditations, including partial recordings, texts and settings will be kept.
Delete “%1$s” completely, or remove only its audio and keep the text and settings? Audio shared with another saved entry will be kept for that entry.
Audio removed; text and settings kept. Shared audio is kept for other entries.
